senses.gloss: הִזְהִיב (denom. of זָהָב) to glitter, contrad. to הצהיב (v. צָהַב).
units: Ḥull. 22ᵇ משיַזְהִיבוּ when their plumage is glittering.—Part. Hof. מוּזְהָב, f. מוּזְהֶבֶת gold-embroidered.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 15:9">Tosef. Sot. XV, 9</cite>, v. <cite ref="G00093"><he>זְהוֹרִית</he></cite>.
